condiments.name: Wallpaper
condiments.description: Give any Snack a background image. Fill, fit or stretch it without changing its source.

agent.instructions: Wallpaper changes the presentation of a Snack, not its HTML. Discover current actions and awareness. Use media-begin/media-chunk/media-finish for an image, wallpaper-state to read existing assignments, and wallpaper-set with an existing Snack id, managed mediaId and fit cover/contain/stretch. Set mediaId to null to remove the wallpaper. Named Snack Bars, Main Snack and saved ChipClips retain their wallpaper assignment. Respect the user’s requested target.

skills.name: snack-wallpaper
skills.description: Apply or remove a wallpaper on a selected Snack.
